title: Stores at the crossing

branches.condition: Military passage is delivered without Guard or an effective Warrant
branches.consequence: Stores are lost in the loading arrangements, worsening civilian shortages. Protection prevents this extra loss; Tender cover cannot protect the stores.

branches.condition: Council Repair is carried out and private Wayfarer Trade completes
branches.consequence: The repaired route and completed commercial voyage improve distribution to Sorenne’s Fall. Both must happen. Routine Maintain work is not this Repair operation.
Neither of these additional supply effects occurs. Other cargo, operation and scenario effects still apply.

guidance: You can seek a different use of the ships or protection while the relevant assignments and orders remain open. This vision promises no extra benefit for an ordinary Relief voyage.
